objective: One real continuous Earth -> Iberia -> Costa Blanca -> Benidoleig -> AUMARA parcel descent using Google Photorealistic 3D Tiles when authorized, then a spatially continuous blend into the accepted V2.1.1 local twin and WP0-WP27 flight at 3.5-4.0 m AGL.

global_world.credits_rule: Google tile attribution must remain visible; use Cesium credit display/showCreditsOnScreen-compatible path.

globalTilesStatus_READY_requires: at least one visible Google 3D tile rendered before descent is called READY
tiles_readiness_gate.if_missing_key_or_auth: Set globalTilesStatus=BLOCKED_GOOGLE_KEY and keep the local twin usable. Do not claim Earth-to-AUMARA descent READY.

descent_path.orientation: Camera must continuously look ahead/down toward the next spatial target; no orientation snap at stage boundaries.
descent_path.timing: Use eased spline/interpolation so velocity and pitch changes are continuous.

blend.footprint_source: canonical cadastral/georeference parcel polygon; never invent a replacement rectangle if parcel polygon exists
blend.global_local_overlap_rule: Do not render Google's parcel geometry through the local twin.
blend.preferred_method: Apply Cesium ClippingPolygonCollection to the Google global tileset over the AUMARA parcel footprint, then inset the georeferenced local GLB inside the clipped region.
visibility_sequence: Above local transition altitude: Google global world dominant; local twin may be preloaded but visually unobtrusive.
During parcel approach: clipped parcel opens and local twin becomes visible without positional jump.
At local flight entry: local twin fully authoritative inside parcel; Google remains contextual outside parcel.
blend.no_crossfade_cheat: A simple full-screen dissolve between unrelated camera/render contexts is not a spatial blend. Camera world coordinates must remain continuous.

fallback.when_global_tiles_blocked: Keep current high-local approach -> WP0-WP27 as usable fallback only.
fallback.label: LOCAL_FALLBACK, not GLOBAL_DESCENT_READY
fallback.do_not: Do not replace Google Photorealistic 3D Tiles with Esri imagery and call the global stage complete.

runtime_proof.capture: one uncut desktop and one uncut mobile run
runtime_proof.start: Earth/global stage after first visible Google 3D tile

stop_rule: Do not redesign landing, rebuild the local twin, create a new project, or call keyframes alone a global descent. Load real Google 3D tiles -> prove first tile -> continuous descent -> clip parcel -> inset local twin -> WP0-WP27 -> record -> commit -> receipt.
